android.desc: Never miss a moment with Pixel Camera! Take fantastic photos and videos using features like Portrait, Night Sight, Time Lapse, and Cinematic Blur. Take stunning photos • HDR+ with Exposure and White Balance Controls and Real Tone - Take incredible true-to-life photos using HDR+, especially in low-light or backlit scenes. • Night Sight - You’ll never want to use your flash again. Night Sight brings out all the details and colors that get lost in the dark. You can even take photos of the Milky Way with Astrophotography! • Magic Capture - Live the moment while your camera captures it. Just tap to start, and your Pixel gets you a video and high-quality photos. • Camera Looks - Personalize your Camera with distinct photographic aesthetics for photos that look true to you • Creator Suite - Creating video content has never been easier with a built-in teleprompter, project folders, audio visualizer for mic checks, and more • Camera Coach - Get suggestions and guidance with the help of Gemini models to take better photos • Auto Best Take - Capture the moment where all your friends look their best. • Super Zoom - Get way close from far away. Super Zoom makes your pictures sharper when you zoom in. • Pro Zoom - Zoom up to 120x, powered by an advanced generative imaging model • Add Me - Get the whole group in your pics, even the person taking the photograph • Long Exposure - Add a creative blur to moving subjects in the scene • Action Pan - Add a creative blur to the background while keeping your subject in focus • Macro Focus - Vivid color and striking contrast in even the smallest subjects • Pro Controls - Unlock advanced camera settings like shutter speed, ISO, and more Incredible videos on every take • Record fluid high fidelity videos in stunning resolution with crisp audio, even in crowded places • Video Boost - Get video with better lighting, colors, and details • Night Sight Video - Relive that perfect moment, even after dark • Portrait - Create a cinematic effect in video by blurring the background behind your subject • Cinematic Pan - Slow down your phone’s panning movements • Long Shot - Take casual, quick videos by simply long-pressing the shutter key while in the default photo mode Requirements - The latest version of Pixel Camera only works on Pixel devices running Android 17 and above. The latest version of Pixel Camera for Wear OS only works on Wear OS 5.1 (and above) devices connected to Pixel phones.

On the other hand, if you switch to the latest Google camera app, you will not really be participating in making the open source version better.
